name: DJ Screw
sources: style-research-extended vol.1 crunk — DJ Screw (the `houston-screw` lane's research section)
notes: ⛔ **This is a producer entry, so the model is the workflow rather than a discography** — and the workflow is a *transformation*, which is the hardest thing this dataset has to say. Nothing here slows or pitches audio: the model writes the record already screwed, so what a turntable does to a source is authored as what it does to MIDI. ▶ **Tempo is the sourced anchor.** "Slowing down the tempo ... to 60 and 70 quarter-note beats per minute" gives 58–70 with a mode of 64 — the base band of the treatment itself, not of a source record, which is why this entry sits at the bottom of the lane's range rather than spanning it. ▶ **The pitch drop is authored as register, because a key name is a label and not a pitch.** "Roughly 2–4 semitones for a 0.8–0.87 rate change" moves every note down, so melody, chords, bass and 808 all drop three semitones off the genre's floors: melody 49–79, chords 37–69, bass 17–36, 808 11–25. Minor-key sources dominate the canon, so the scale weights stay minor with phrygian present. ▶ **"Skipping beats, record scratching, stop-time" is three parameters.** `kick.beatSkipProb` 0.26 is the beat skip; `snare.clusterProb` 0.30 with 2–3 hits is the stutter-repeat; `arrangement.transitions.dropOutBeats` at 0.8 for 4 beats is the stop-time. The scratch is the `reverse` lane, promoted to the head of `percs` at 1–3 per bar with `placement` `any` — a lane triggered anywhere in the bar is what a scratch is, and it is the only lane in this dataset that reads backwards. ⛔ **`bass808.monoCutSelf` is `false`, and it is a direct quote.** "Low-end emphasis increases because the decay overlaps the next hit" — a sub that is not cut by the note after it is exactly that. Its parent sets it true; this is the one place a screwed record differs from its own genre, and the key sits on the engine's deferral register rather than being implemented. The bass rhythm stays `mirror_kick` at 0.96 because a held-note rhythm collapses to one note per chord. ▶ **"Nothing is added — the treatment is transformational."** So `chords.impliedByRiff` is set, `maxChords` falls to 2, `melody.loopVerbatim` is on with `endVariation` off, and `motifPitchCount` drops to 2–4: chopping is "dividing it into smaller segments and reconfiguring them", which is a short fragment re-triggered, not a new melody. `phraseBars` gives 1-bar real weight for the same reason. ▶ **The doubled phrase is the counter.** "A bar or phrase repeated immediately" is `octave_echo` at weight 6 with `echoOffset` of a quarter note — at 64 BPM a beat-late double is what an immediate repeat sounds like. ⚠ **The two moving chord families are the source records' own harmony, retained rather than invented**, and they carry the low weights; the static i is what the treatment leaves behind. They stay because the chord part still owes a producer 55 distinct outputs and the bass needs more than one root to reach. ⚠ **The loosest quantize and widest jitter in the batch** — 0.82 and up to 9 ms — are the research's "attacks soften and decays lengthen" said as timing, and the velocity tiers are the softest anywhere in the dataset. Both are INFERRED: the research says the attacks soften, not by how much. ⚠ **Fill fingerprint.** `gapProb` 0.65 / `descendProb` 0.22 / `rampJitter` 22 over 8th-triplets, even grouping, ramping 62–114 — the gappiest and most jittered roll in the band, which is a roll played by hand on a slowed record rather than programmed. ⚠ `anticipationProb` raised to 0.15. With `mirror_kick` against a fully locked 808 both parts take every kick, so every bass onset lands exactly on an 808 onset — `coherence.rs` calls that one line played twice rather than two parts locking. The lock is the style and is untouched; the anticipation is what makes them two parts. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,4,1], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
